title: 32 Million in Meta Puts Hit in a 22-Second Window
speaker: tastylive Signal vs. Noise host

macro_themes.view: Market is in a 'what have you done for me recently' mode, judging big tech on whether margins rise or collapse amid heavy capex.

calls.reason: $32M of urgent put buying: ~$14.3M in Oct 16 740/730 puts fading the 4% rally, ~$18M in Nov 20 710-740 puts through Nov 4 earnings needing a drift back toward 700; last quarter's capex surge and FCF collapse gives a fundamental case for protection.
calls.quote: those are the immediate downside bets that whatever upside that we've seen here today it's going to fade and fade quickly.

notes: Bias reflects the unusual put flow, not an explicit host view; host cautions it may be hedging rather than an outright short. Street consensus target $805.80 is bullish. Date from 'October 16th... four days to expiration' and 'start of the week' (Monday).
